facts.fact: Kate 在 Aiden Berkeley 面前连声道歉，称一切都是误会。
facts.anchor: ‘Oh my God, sorry,’ stammered Kate. ‘It was all a mistake.’

facts.fact: 即便已有人被捕、即便 Berkeley 可能与新案无关，她仍不愿空手离开。
facts.anchor: Even if there had already been an arrest. Even if he probably had nothing to do with the latest murder.

facts.fact: Kate 借上厕所翻看药柜与抽屉，自称职业窥探者。
facts.anchor: She was a professional snooper and you could learn a lot about someone from what was in their bathroom cabinet.

facts.fact: 她提起当年的谣言，Berkeley 厉声否认。
Berkeley 自称昨天上班前从新闻里听说 Emily 旧房间里的女孩死在同一栋房子。
facts.anchor: I was as shocked as anyone when I heard on the news before work yesterday morning that a girl who lived in Emily’s old room had been killed in the same house.

facts.fact: Kate 意识到早间新闻并未报道 Olivia 死在 Emily 同一栋房子，这个关联是后来才出现的。
facts.anchor: But it wasn’t reported yesterday morning that Olivia had been killed in the same house as Emily.

facts.fact: Smith 在电话里说 Elliot 被抓了，语气毫不意外。
Kate 捶方向盘，坚持认为不是 Elliot 干的。
facts.anchor: ‘But I don’t think Elliot did it!’
